$comment: Entry schema for contributes.fileIcons (declarative and process plugins). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_file_icons.go. Every iconDefinitions path is a package-relative .svg or .png file under fileicons/, icons/ or assets/ (max 32 KiB each). SVGs must pass the host allowlist sanitizer (plugins/api/svgsafe): svg, g, defs, symbol, use, path, rect, circle, ellipse, line, polyline, polygon, linearGradient, radialGradient, stop, clipPath, mask, title and desc only; no script, style, foreignObject, image, text, a or animation elements, no style or on* attributes, href only as a local #id, url() only as url(#id), no DOCTYPE/entities/CDATA/processing instructions; root needs a viewBox. PNGs are at most 256x256 pixels and are re-encoded. Mapping keys are case-insensitive; every mapping value must be an iconDefinitions id. v1 has no languageIds mapping.
description: File icon themes for the project tree and document tabs: inline themes or {"path"} references to JSON files inside the package.

monochrome.description: Render icons as a mask tinted with the current text color.

path.description: Package-relative icon file, for example fileicons/ts.svg.

light.description: Overrides used while a light MinCode theme is active.

fileIconExtensionMap.description: Extension without the leading dot (compound extensions such as d.ts allowed) to icon definition id.

fileIconNameMap.description: Exact file or folder name (case-insensitive, no path separators) to icon definition id.
